dialogues.jp:
ベッドに腰掛け、壁に掛けてあるカレンダーを
見る。
dialogues.en:
I sat on my bed, looking at the calendar hanging on the
wall.
dialogues.text:
I sat on my bed, looking at the calendar hanging on the
wall.

dialogues.jp: 明日で付属の授業も終わりだ。
dialogues.en: Tomorrow is when classes end for the semester.
dialogues.text: Tomorrow is when classes end for the semester.

dialogues.jp:
卒業式や卒パの準備があるとは言え、来月の入
学式まで、休みが丁度１ヶ月あることになる。
dialogues.en:
From the time the graduation party preparations begin to
when I enter my new school, leaves me about one month of
rest.
dialogues.text:
From the time the graduation party preparations begin to
when I enter my new school, leaves me about one month of
rest.

dialogues.jp:
「明後日の登校日をこなせば、自由登校に入る
　のか」
dialogues.en:
"There will still be school after tomorrow, but attendance
won't be taken anymore."
dialogues.text:
"There will still be school after tomorrow, but attendance
won't be taken anymore."

dialogues.jp: その先の日付を見ながら、何をするかを考える。
dialogues.en: Wonder what I'd do for the last day of school...
dialogues.text: Wonder what I'd do for the last day of school...

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、呼び出しを食らわないよう、真面
目に登校しないとな。
dialogues.en:
In any case, as long as I don't get called to school for
some special reason after tomorrow, I probably won't bother
going.
dialogues.text:
In any case, as long as I don't get called to school for
some special reason after tomorrow, I probably won't bother
going.

dialogues.jp:
俺は目覚ましに手を伸ばすと、最良の時間を考
え、セットする。
dialogues.en:
I took the alarm clock from my bedside table, and started
thinking about the best time to set it to.
dialogues.text:
I took the alarm clock from my bedside table, and started
thinking about the best time to set it to.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、寝た。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I slept.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I slept.

dialogues.jp:
明日はいよいよ付属最後の授業日だ。それ以降
は卒業まで、自由登校となる。
dialogues.en:
Tomorrow's the long-awaited last day of classes. After that
is graduation party preparations, so no attendance marked.
dialogues.text:
Tomorrow's the long-awaited last day of classes. After that
is graduation party preparations, so no attendance marked.

dialogues.jp: さて、目覚ましかけて寝るか。
dialogues.en: Now then, time to set the alarm clock and sleep.
dialogues.text: Now then, time to set the alarm clock and sleep.
